name: sdd-pp
description: OpenSpec handoff workflow: custom schemas + AI Hero / Superpowers handoff wrappers, split gate and loss check. Install with: npx <this-repo> init --tool ai-hero|superpowers

scripts.validate:example: cd example && openspec schema validate handoff-driven && openspec validate --all --strict && node .openspec-handoff/scripts/check-handoff.mjs add-greeting-name
